desc: Prove that every directed cycle forces all its vertices to share one value, and reduce the graph to cycles with rooted in-trees attached.
Derive the DP recurrence for a vertex and its tree children, including prefix-sum computation modulo 998244353.
Implement indegree peeling robustly, distinguishing cycle vertices from removed tree vertices and producing a valid bottom-up processing order.
Combine processed tree contributions for each cycle and sum over the shared cycle value, including self-loops and multiple components.
Provide the final iterative, memory-conscious Python solution and verify it against all samples and edge cases.
